'''Impending Doom''' is a [[support gem]] for [[hex]] [[curse]]s. When the hex on the supported skill expires, it triggers Doom Blast to deal [[chaos damage]] in an [[area of effect|area]] around it. It cannot support curse skills which are [[trigger]]ed or applied as an aura with {{il|Blasphemy Support}}.

==Skill functions and interactions==
Doom Blast is considered a [[spell]], therefore modifiers to spell damage apply to it.

Doom Blast is triggered when a hex ends, and its damage benefits from bonuses of the ending hex. E.g. the reduced chaos resistance from [[Despair]].

Due to animation timing differences between [[classes]], some classes like [[ranger]]s require slightly more [[cast speed]] than classes like witches when using a curse with Impending Doom and a different curse with {{il|Spell Cascade Support}} triggered through {{il|Vixen's Entrapment}}.<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3426210/page/1#p25094323</ref>

}}

In addition, {{c|foulborn|Foulborn}} {{il|Doedre's Scorn}} also grant this support to gem socketed in that item.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.25.0|
* Doom Blast now has 220% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 1, scaling up to 370% at gem level 20 (previously 370% at all gem levels).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.23.0|
* Fixed some incorrect behaviour<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3414799/page/6#p25068804</ref> with the spacing of Spell Cascade with Curse skills that was inadvertently fixed in 3.22.0 before being reinstated temporarily in 3.22.0b.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.20.0|
* Doom Blast, from the Impending Doom Support, now deals 102 to 154 Chaos Damage at gem level 1 (previously 54 to 81), up to 1654 to 2481 at gem level 20 (previously 868 to 1301).
* Now has 370% Effectiveness of Added Damage at all gem levels (previously 200%).
* Quality on the Divergent Impending Doom Support no longer has 0 to -25% more Damage with Hits per 5 Doom on Hex. Instead, it now has 0-40% reduced Cooldown Recovery Rate.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.17.0|
* Doom Blast: Now deals 54 to 81 Chaos Damage at gem level 1 (unchanged), up to 868 to 1301 at gem level 20 (previously 602 to 903). Now has 200% Effectiveness of Added Damage at all gem levels (previously 140%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.16.0|
* Doom Blast (from Impending Doom Support) now deals 54 to 81 Chaos Damage at gem level 1 (previously 39 to 58), up to 602 to 903 at gem level 20 (previously 430 to 645).
* It now has “40% more Damage with Hits per 5 Doom on Hex”, and “15% more Damage with Ailments per 5 Doom on Hex”. It no longer has “60% more Damage per 5 Doom on Hex”.
* It now has 140% Effectiveness of Added Damage at all gem levels (previously 100%). Because of base Ignite damage changes, Ignite with the skill is now 44.6% higher at 30 Doom, and 32.8% higher at 40 doom.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.15.0d|
* Impending Doom Support now has a Cost and Reservation Multiplier of 130% (previously 140%).
}}
{{Version history table row |3.13.0|
* Doom Blast now has an added damage effectiveness of 100% (from 50%).
* Doom Blast now deals 39 to 58 chaos damage at gem level 1 (from 25 to 37), up to 430 to 645 chaos damage at gem level 20 (from 216 to 325).
* Doom Blast now deals 60% more damage per 5 doom on hex (from 50% more).
}}
{{Version history table row |3.12.0|
* Impending Doom Support has been added to the game.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
